answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The way a knoll roots the soil, a ledge returns each spring, and a quill reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
